credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Four sided container for tea with lids and rounded corners solid dark green in color on lid and at top and bottom. Middle has background designs of turquoise and white vertical stripes and floral patterns. Non-English lettering on top of lid and sides of container. Side reads in circular green emblem with gold outline. "Extra Choicest Chuan Shang Jasmine Tea." Other side reads in dark green lettering. "Chuan Shang Jasmine Tea Extra Choicest Quality Fragrant and Refreshing." Rounded corners, gold colored metal banding at base of container and lid. Gold colored metal bottom and underside of lid. Rounded corners. Circular gold colored metal inner cap on top of container beneath lid.

title: Container, Jasmine Tea
